title: Combine every technique into a system

body.text: Real work often mixes several techniques: use
to act and save results. Designing a workflow means deciding which step uses what, so they flow together toward a goal.

example: Workflow: RAG finds the policy → summarize in plain language → write an email to the team → save it to the system

title: Start small, measure, scale

body.text: Don't build a huge workflow all at once —
start with the key steps, test, measure, then expand
. Always have a 'human-in-the-loop' checkpoint at risky points to catch mistakes before anything goes live.

example: Start with RAG + summarize; once it works well, add an auto-email step with a person approving it
